mn26:1.2: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā sāvatthiyaṃ viharati jetavane anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme.
mn26:2.1: atha kho bhagavā pubbanhasamayaṃ nivāsetvā pattacīvaraṃ ādāya sāvatthiṃ piṇḍāya pāvisi.
mn26:2.2: atha kho sambahulā bhikkhū yenāyasmā ānando tenupasaṅkamiṃsu. upasaṅkamitvā āyasmantaṃ ānandaṃ etadavocuṃ:
mn26:2.3: “cirassutā no āvuso ānanda bhagavato sammukhā dhammī kathā.
mn26:2.4: sādhu mayaṃ āvuso ānanda labheyyāma bhagavato sammukhā dhammiṃ kathaṃ savaṇāyā”ti.
mn26:2.5: tenahāyasmanto yena rammakassa brāhmaṇassa assamo tenupasaṅkamatha.
mn26:2.6: appevanāma labheyyātha bhagavato sammukhā dhammiṃ kathaṃ savanāyāti.
mn26:2.7: evamāvusoti kho te bhikkhū āyasmato ānandassa paccassosuṃ.
mn26:3.1: atha kho bhagavā sāvatthiyaṃ piṇḍāya caritvā pacchābhattaṃ piṇḍapātapaṭikkanto āyasmantaṃ ānandaṃ āmantesi:
mn26:3.2: āyāmānanda yena pubbārāmo migāramātu pāsādo tenupasaṅkamissāma divāvihārāyāti.
mn26:3.3: evambhanteti kho āyasmā ānando bhagavato paccassosi.
mn26:3.4: atha kho bhagavā āyasmatā ānandena saddhiṃ yena pubbārāmo migāramātupāsādo tenupasaṅkami divāvihārāya.
mn26:3.5: atha kho bhagavā sāyanhasamayaṃ paṭisallānā vuṭṭhito āyasmantaṃ ānandaṃ āmantesi:
mn26:3.6: āyāmānanda yena pubbakoṭṭhako tenupasaṅkamissāma gattāni parisiñcitunti.
mn26:3.7: evambhanteti kho āyasmā ānando bhagavato paccassosi.
mn26:3.8: atha kho bhagavā āyasmatā ānandena saddhiṃ yena pubbakoṭṭhako tenupasaṅkami gattāni parisiñcituṃ.
mn26:3.9: pubbakoṭṭhake gattāni parisiñcitvā paccuttaritvā ekacīvaro aṭṭhāsi gattāni pubbāpayamāno.
mn26:3.10: atha kho āyasmā ānando bhagavantaṃ etadavoca:
mn26:3.11: ayaṃ bhante rammakassa brāhmaṇassa assamo avidūre.
mn26:3.14: sādhu bhante bhagavā yena rammakassa brāhmaṇassa assamo tenupasaṅkamatu anukampaṃ upādāyāti.
mn26:4.1: atha kho bhagavā yena rammakassa brāhmaṇassa assamo tenupasaṅkami.
mn26:4.2: tena kho pana samayena sambahulā bhikkhū rammakassa brāhmaṇassa assame dhammiyā kathāya sannisinnā honti.
mn26:4.3: atha kho bhagavā bahidvārakoṭṭhake aṭṭhāsi kathāpariyosānaṃ āgamayamāno.
mn26:4.4: atha kho bhagavā kathāpariyosānaṃ viditvā ukkāsitvā aggaḷaṃ ākoṭesi.
mn26:4.5: vivariṃsu kho te bhikkhū bhagavato dvāraṃ.
mn26:4.6: atha kho bhagavā rammakassa brāhmaṇassa assamaṃ pavisitvā paññatte āsane nisīdi.
mn26:4.8: “kāyanuttha bhikkhave etarahi kathāya sannisinnā, kā ca pana vo antarā kathā vippakatā’ti.
mn26:4.9: ‘bhagavantameva kho no bhante ārabbha dhammī kathā vippakatā, atha bhagavā anuppatto’ti.
mn26:4.11: etaṃ kho bhikkhave tumhākaṃ patirūpaṃ kulaputtānaṃ saddhā agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajitānaṃ yaṃ tumhe dhammiyā kathāya sannisīdeyyātha.
mn26:4.13: dhammī vā kathā ariyo vā tuṇhībhāvo.
mn26:5.2: ariyā ca pariyesanā anariyā ca pariyesanā.
mn26:5.4: idha bhikkhave ekacco attanā jātidhammo samāno jātidhammaññeva pariyesati, attanā jarādhammo samāno jarādhammaññeva pariyesati, attanā byādhidhammo samāno byādhidhammaññeva pariyesati, attanā maraṇadhammo samāno maraṇadhammaññeva pariyesati, attanā sokadhammo samāno sokadhammaññeva pariyesati, attanā saṅkilesadhammo samāno saṅkilesadhammaññeva pariyesati.
mn26:6.2: puttabhariyaṃ bhikkhave jātidhammaṃ, dāsidāsaṃ jātidhammaṃ, ajeḷakaṃ jātidhammaṃ, kukkuṭasūkaraṃ jātidhammaṃ, hatthigavāssavaḷavaṃ jātidhammaṃ, jātarūparajataṃ jātidhammaṃ.
mn26:6.4: etthāyaṃ gathito mucchito ajjhāpanno attanā jātidhammo samāno jātidhammaññeva pariyesati.
mn26:7.2: puttabhariyaṃ bhikkhave jarādhammaṃ, dāsidāsaṃ jarādhammaṃ, ajeḷakaṃ jarādhammaṃ, kukkuṭasūkaraṃ jarādhammaṃ, hatthigavāssavaḷavaṃ jarādhammaṃ , jātarūparajataṃ jarādhammaṃ.
mn26:7.4: etthāyaṃ gathito mucchito ajjhāpanno attanā jarādhammo samāno jarādhammaññeva pariyesati.
mn26:8.2: puttabhariyaṃ bhikkhave byādhidhammaṃ, dāsidāsaṃ byādhidhammaṃ, ajeḷakaṃ byādhidhammaṃ, kukkuṭasūkaraṃ byādhidhammaṃ, hatthigavāssavaḷavaṃ byādhidhammaṃ.
mn26:8.4: etthāyaṃ gathito mucchito ajjhāpanno attanā byādhidhammo samāno byādhidhammaññeva pariyesati.
mn26:9.2: puttabhariyaṃ bhikkhave maraṇadhammaṃ, dāsidāsaṃ maraṇadhammaṃ, ajeḷakaṃ maraṇadhammaṃ, kukkuṭasūkaraṃ maraṇadhammaṃ, hatthigavāssavaḷavaṃ maraṇadhammaṃ.
mn26:9.4: etthāyaṃ gathito mucchito ajjhāpanno attanā maraṇadhammo samāno maraṇadhammaññeva pariyesati.
mn26:10.2: puttabhariyaṃ bhikkhave sokadhammaṃ, dāsidāsaṃ sokadhammaṃ, ajeḷakaṃ sokadhammaṃ, kukkuṭasūkaraṃ sokadhammaṃ, hatthigavāssavaḷavaṃ sokadhammaṃ.
mn26:10.4: etthāyaṃ gathito mucchito ajjhāpanno attanā sokadhammo samāno sokadhammaññeva pariyesati.
mn26:11.2: puttabhariyaṃ bhikkhave saṅkilesadhammaṃ, dāsidāsaṃ saṅkilesadhammaṃ, ajeḷakaṃ saṅkilesadhammaṃ, kukkuṭasūkaraṃ saṅkilesadhammaṃ, hatthigavāssavaḷavaṃ saṅkilesadhammaṃ, jātarūparajataṃ saṅkilesadhammaṃ.
mn26:11.4: etthāyaṃ gathito mucchito ajjhāpanno attanā saṅkilesadhammo samāno saṅkilesadhammaññeva pariyesati.
mn26:12.2: idha bhikkhave ekacco attanā jātidhammo samāno jātidhamme ādīnavaṃ viditvā ajātaṃ anuttaraṃ yogakkhemaṃ nibbānaṃ pariyesati, attanā jarādhammo samāno jarādhamme ādīnavaṃ viditvā ajaraṃ anuttaraṃ yogakkhemaṃ nibbānaṃ pariyesati, attanā byādhidhammo samāno byādhidhamme ādīnavaṃ viditvā abyādhiṃ anuttaraṃ yogakkhemaṃ nibbānaṃ pariyesati, attanā maraṇadhammo samāno maraṇadhamme ādīnavaṃ viditvā amataṃ anuttaraṃ yogakkhemaṃ nibbānaṃ pariyesati, attanā sokadhammo samāno sokadhamme ādīnavaṃ viditvā asokaṃ anuttaraṃ yogakkhemaṃ nibbānaṃ pariyesati, attanā saṅkilesadhammo samāno saṅkilesadhamme ādīnavaṃ viditvā asaṅkiliṭṭhaṃ anuttaraṃ yogakkhemaṃ nibbānaṃ pariyesati.
mn26:13.1: ahampi sudaṃ bhikkhave pubbeva sambodhā anabhisambuddho bodhisattova samāno attanā jātidhammo samāno jātidhammaññeva pariyesāmi, attanā jarādhammo samāno jarādhammaññeva pariyesāmi, attanā byādhidhammo samāno byādhidhammaññeva pariyesāmi, attanā maraṇadhammo samāno maraṇadhammaññeva pariyesāmi, attanā sokadhammo samāno sokadhammaññeva pariyesāmi, attanā saṅkilesadhammo samāno saṅkilesadhammaññeva pariyesāmi.
mn26:13.3: “kinnu kho ahaṃ attanā jātidhammo samāno jātidhammaññeva pariyesāmi, attanā jarādhammo samāno jarādhammaññeva pariyesāmi, attanā byādhidhammo samāno byādhidhammaññeva pariyesāmi, attanā maraṇadhammo samāno maraṇadhammaññeva pariyesāmi, attanā sokadhammo samāno sokadhammaññeva pariyesāmi, attanā saṅkilesadhammo samāno saṅkilesadhammaññeva pariyesāmi,
mn26:13.4: yannūnāhaṃ attanā jātidhammo samāno jātidhamme ādīnavaṃ viditvā ajātaṃ anuttaraṃ yogakkhemaṃ nibbānaṃ pariyeseyyaṃ, attanā jarādhammo samāno jarādhamme ādīnavaṃ viditvā ajaraṃ anuttaraṃ yogakkhemaṃ nibbānaṃ pariyeseyyaṃ, attanā byādhidhammo samāno byādhidhamme ādīnavaṃ viditvā abyādhiṃ anuttaraṃ yogakkhemaṃ nibbānaṃ pariyeseyyaṃ, attanā maraṇadhammo samāno maraṇadhamme ādīnavaṃ viditvā amataṃ anuttaraṃ yogakkhemaṃ nibbānaṃ pariyeseyyaṃ, attanā sokadhammo samāno sokadhamme ādīnavaṃ viditvā asokaṃ anuttaraṃ yogakkhemaṃ nibbānaṃ pariyeseyyaṃ, attanā saṅkilesadhammo samāno saṅkilesadhamme ādīnavaṃ viditvā asaṅkiliṭṭhaṃ anuttaraṃ yogakkhemaṃ nibbānaṃ pariyeseyya”nti.
mn26:14.1: so kho ahaṃ bhikkhave aparena samayena daharova samāno susukāḷakeso bhadrena yobbanena samannāgato paṭhamena vayasā, akāmakānaṃ mātāpitunnaṃ assumukhānaṃ rudantānaṃ, kesamassuṃ ohāretvā kāsāyāni vatthāni acchādetvā agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajiṃ.
mn26:15.1: so evaṃ pabbajito samāno kiṃ kusalagavesī anuttaraṃ santivarapadaṃ pariyesamāno yena āḷāro kālāmo tenupasaṅkamiṃ. upasaṅkamitvā āḷāraṃ kālāmaṃ etadavocaṃ:
mn26:15.2: ‘icchāmahaṃ āvuso kālāma imasmiṃ dhammavinaye brahmacariyaṃ caritu’nti.
mn26:15.3: evaṃ vutte bhikkhave āḷāro kālāmo maṃ etadavoca:
mn26:15.5: tādiso ayaṃ dhammo yattha viññū puriso nacirasseva sakaṃ ācariyakaṃ sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja vihareyyā”ti.
mn26:15.6: so kho ahaṃ bhikkhave nacirasseva khippameva taṃ dhammaṃ pariyāpuṇiṃ.
mn26:15.7: so kho ahaṃ bhikkhave tāvatakeneva oṭṭhapahatamattena lapitalāpanamattena ñāṇavādañca vadāmi theravādañca. ‘jānāmi passāmī’ti ca paṭijānāmi ahañceva aññe ca.
mn26:15.9: “na kho āḷāro kālāmo imaṃ dhammaṃ kevalaṃ saddhāmattakena sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja viharāmīti pavedeti.
mn26:15.10: addhā āḷāro kālāmo imaṃ dhammaṃ jānaṃ passaṃ viharatī”ti.
mn26:15.11: atha khvāhaṃ bhikkhave yena āḷāro kālāmo tenupasaṅkamiṃ. upasaṅkamitvā āḷāraṃ kālāmaṃ etadavocaṃ:
mn26:15.12: “kittāvatā no āvuso kālāma imaṃ dhammaṃ sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja pavedesī”ti.
mn26:15.13: evaṃ vutte bhikkhave āḷāro kālāmo ākiñcaññāyatanaṃ pavedesi.
mn26:15.15: “na kho āḷārasseva kālāmassa atthi saddhā, mayhampatthi saddhā.
mn26:15.16: na kho āḷārasseva kālāmassa atthi viriyaṃ, mayhampatthi viriyaṃ.
mn26:15.17: na kho āḷārasseva kālāmassa atthi sati, mayhampatthi sati.
mn26:15.18: na kho āḷārasseva kālāmassa atthi samādhi, mayhampatthi samādhi.
mn26:15.19: na kho āḷārasseva kālāmassa atthi paññā, mayhampatthi paññā.
mn26:15.20: yannūnāhaṃ yaṃ dhammaṃ āḷāro kālāmo ‘sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja viharāmī’ti pavedeti. tassa dhammassa sacchikiriyāya padaheyya”nti.
mn26:15.21: so kho ahaṃ bhikkhave nacirasseva khippameva taṃ dhammaṃ sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja vihāsiṃ.
mn26:15.22: atha khvāhaṃ bhikkhave yena āḷāro kālāmo tenupasaṅkamiṃ. upasaṅkamitvā āḷāraṃ kālāmaṃ etadavocaṃ:
mn26:15.23: “ettāvatā no, āvuso kālāma, imaṃ dhammaṃ sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja pavedesī”ti.
mn26:15.24: ‘ettāvatā kho ahaṃ āvuso imaṃ dhammaṃ sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja pavedemī’ti.
mn26:15.25: “ahampi kho āvuso ettāvatā imaṃ dhammaṃ sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja viharāmī”ti.
mn26:15.27: ye mayaṃ āyasmantaṃ tādisaṃ sabrahmacāriṃ passāma,
mn26:15.28: iti yāhaṃ dhammaṃ sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja pavedemi, taṃ tvaṃ dhammaṃ sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja viharasi,
mn26:15.29: yaṃ tvaṃ dhammaṃ sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja viharasi, tamahaṃ dhammaṃ sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja pavedemi.
mn26:15.30: iti yāhaṃ dhammaṃ jānāmi, taṃ tvaṃ dhammaṃ jānāsi, yaṃ tvaṃ dhammaṃ jānāsi, tamahaṃ dhammaṃ jānāmi.
mn26:15.31: iti yādiso ahaṃ, tādiso tvaṃ, yādiso tvaṃ, tādiso ahaṃ.
mn26:15.32: ehidāni āvuso, ubhova santā imaṃ gaṇaṃ pariharāmā’ti.
mn26:15.33: iti kho bhikkhave āḷāro kālāmo ācariyo me samāno antevāsiṃ maṃ samānaṃ attano samasamaṃ ṭhapesi, uḷārāya ca maṃ pūjāya pūjesi.
mn26:15.35: “nāyaṃ dhammo nibbidāya na virāgāya na nirodhāya na upasamāya na abhiññāya na sambodhāya na nibbānāya saṃvattati, yāvadeva ākiñcaññāyatanupapattiyā”ti.
mn26:15.36: so kho ahaṃ bhikkhave taṃ dhammaṃ analaṃkaritvā tasmā dhammā nibbijja apakkamiṃ.
mn26:16.1: so kho ahaṃ bhikkhave kiṃ kusalagavesī anuttaraṃ santivarapadaṃ pariyesamāno yena uddako rāmaputto tenupasaṅkamiṃ. upasaṅkamitvā uddakaṃ rāmaputtaṃ etadavocaṃ:
mn26:16.3: evaṃ vutte bhikkhave uddako rāmaputto maṃ etadavoca
mn26:16.5: tādiso ayaṃ dhammo yattha viññū puriso nacirasseva sakaṃ ācariyakaṃ sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja vihareyyā’ti.
mn26:16.6: so kho ahaṃ bhikkhave nacirasseva khippameva taṃ dhammaṃ pariyāpuṇiṃ.
mn26:16.7: so kho ahaṃ bhikkhave tāvatakeneva oṭṭhapahatamattena lapitalāpanamattena ñāṇavādañca vadāmi theravādañca. ‘jānāmi, passāmī’ti ca paṭijānāmi ahañceva aññe ca.
mn26:16.9: “na kho rāmo imaṃ dhammaṃ kevalaṃ saddhāmattakena sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja viharāmīti pavedesi.
mn26:16.10: addhā rāmo imaṃ dhammaṃ jānaṃ passaṃ vihāsī”ti.
mn26:16.11: atha khvāhaṃ bhikkhave yena uddako rāmaputto tenupasaṅkamiṃ. upasaṅkamitvā uddakaṃ rāmaputtaṃ etadavocaṃ:
mn26:16.12: “kittāvatā no āvuso rāmo imaṃ dhammaṃ sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja pavedesī”ti.
mn26:16.13: evaṃ vutte bhikkhave uddako rāmaputto nevasaññānāsaññāyatanaṃ pavedesi.
mn26:16.15: “na kho rāmasseva ahosi saddhā, mayhampatthi saddhā.
mn26:16.16: na kho rāmasseva ahosi viriyaṃ, mayhampatthi viriyaṃ.
mn26:16.17: na kho rāmasseva ahosi sati, mayhampatthi sati.
mn26:16.18: na kho rāmasseva ahosi samādhi, mayhampatthi samādhi.
mn26:16.19: na kho rāmasseva ahosi paññā, mayhampatthi paññā.
mn26:16.20: yannūnāhaṃ yaṃ dhammaṃ rāmo sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja viharāmīti pavedesi, tassa dhammassa sacchikiriyāya padaheyya”nti.
mn26:16.21: so kho ahaṃ bhikkhave nacirasseva khippameva taṃ dhammaṃ sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja vihāsiṃ.
mn26:16.22: atha khvāhaṃ bhikkhave yena uddako rāmaputto tenupasaṅkamiṃ. upasaṅkamitvā uddakaṃ rāmaputtaṃ etadavocaṃ:
mn26:16.23: “ettāvatā no āvuso rāmo imaṃ dhammaṃ sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja pavedesīti?
mn26:16.24: ‘ettāvatā kho rāmo āvuso imaṃ dhammaṃ sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja pavedesī’ti.
mn26:16.25: ahampi kho āvuso ettāvatā imaṃ dhammaṃ sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja viharāmī”ti.
mn26:16.27: ye mayaṃ āyasmantaṃ tādisaṃ sabrahmacāriṃ passāma.
mn26:16.28: iti yaṃ dhammaṃ rāmo sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja pavedesi, taṃ tvaṃ dhammaṃ sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja viharasi.
mn26:16.29: yaṃ tvaṃ dhammaṃ sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja viharasi, taṃ dhammaṃ rāmo sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja pavedesi.
mn26:16.30: iti yaṃ dhammaṃ rāmo aññāsi, taṃ tvaṃ dhammaṃ jānāsi. yaṃ tvaṃ dhammaṃ jānāsi, taṃ dhammaṃ rāmo aññāsi.
mn26:16.31: iti yādiso rāmo ahosi. tādiso tvaṃ, yādiso tvaṃ, tādiso rāmo ahosi.
mn26:16.32: ehidāni āvuso, tvaṃ imaṃ gaṇaṃ pariharā”ti.
mn26:16.33: iti kho bhikkhave uddako rāmaputto sabrahmacārī me samāno ācariyaṭṭhāne ca maṃ ṭhapesi. uḷārāya ca maṃ pūjāya pūjesi.
mn26:16.35: nāyaṃ dhammo nibbidāya na virāgāya na nirodhāya na nibbānāya saṃvattati, yāvadeva nevasaññānāsaññāyatanūpapattiyāti.
mn26:16.36: so kho ahaṃ bhikkhave taṃ dhammaṃ analaṃkaritvā tasmā dhammā nibbijja apakkamiṃ.
mn26:17.1: so kho ahaṃ bhikkhave kiṃkusalagavesī anuttaraṃ santivarapadaṃ pariyesamāno magadhesu anupubbena cārikaṃ caramāno yena uruvelā senānigamo tadavasariṃ.
mn26:17.2: tatthaddasaṃ ramaṇīyaṃ bhūmibhāgaṃ, pāsādikañca vanasaṇḍaṃ, nadiñca sandantiṃ setakaṃ supatitthaṃ ramaṇīyaṃ, samantā ca gocaragāmaṃ.
mn26:17.4: “ramaṇīyo vata bhūmibhāgo pāsādiko ca vanasaṇḍo, nadī ca sandati setakā supatitthā ramaṇīyā, samantā ca gocaragāmo.
mn26:17.6: so kho ahaṃ bhikkhave tattheva nisīdiṃ
mn26:18.1: so kho ahaṃ bhikkhave attanā jātidhammo samāno jātidhamme ādīnavaṃ viditvā ajātaṃ anuttaraṃ yogakkhemaṃ nibbānaṃ pariyesamāno ajātaṃ anuttaraṃ yogakkhemaṃ nibbānaṃ ajjhagamaṃ. attanā jarādhammo samāno jarādhamme ādīnavaṃ viditvā ajaraṃ anuttaraṃ yogakkhemaṃ nibbānaṃ pariyesamāno ajaraṃ anuttaraṃ yogakkhemaṃ nibbānaṃ ajjhagamaṃ. attanā byādhidhammo samāno byādhidhamme ādīnavaṃ viditvā abyādhiṃ anuttaraṃ yogakkhemaṃ nibbānaṃ pariyesamāno abyādhiṃ anuttaraṃ yogakkhemaṃ nibbānaṃ ajjhagamaṃ. attanā maraṇadhammo samāno maraṇadhamme ādīnavaṃ viditvā amataṃ anuttaraṃ yogakkhemaṃ nibbānaṃ pariyesamāno amataṃ anuttaraṃ yogakkhemaṃ nibbānaṃ ajjhagamaṃ. – attanā sokadhammo samāno sokadhamme ādīnavaṃ viditvā asokaṃ anuttaraṃ yogakkhemaṃ nibbānaṃ pariyesamāno asokaṃ anuttaraṃ yogakkhemaṃ nibbānaṃ ajjhagamaṃ. attanā saṅkilesadhammo samāno saṅkilesadhamme ādīnavaṃ viditvā asaṅkiliṭṭhaṃ anuttaraṃ yogakkhemaṃ nibbānaṃ pariyesamāno asaṅkiliṭṭhaṃ anuttaraṃ yogakkhemaṃ nibbānaṃ ajjhagamaṃ.
mn26:18.3: ‘akuppā me vimutti, ayamantimā jāti. natthi dāni punabbhavo’ti.
mn26:19.2: adhigato kho myāyaṃ dhammo gambhīro duddaso duranubodho santo paṇīto atakkāvacaro nipuṇo paṇḍitavedanīyo.
mn26:19.3: ālayarāmā kho panāyaṃ pajā ālayaratā ālayasammuditā.
mn26:19.4: ālayarāmāya kho pana pajāya ālayaratāya ālayasammuditāya duddasaṃ idaṃ ṭhānaṃ yadidaṃ idappaccayatāpaṭiccasamuppādo.
mn26:19.5: idampi kho ṭhānaṃ duddasaṃ yadidaṃ sabbasaṅkhārasamatho sabbūpadhipaṭinissaggo taṇhakkhayo virāgo nirodho nibbānaṃ.
mn26:19.6: ahañceva kho pana dhammaṃ deseyyaṃ pare ca me na ājāneyyuṃ, so mamassa kilamatho, sā mamassa vihesāti.
mn26:19.7: apissu maṃ bhikkhave imā anacchariyā gāthā paṭibhaṃsu pubbe assutapubbā:
mn26:19.16: itiha me bhikkhave paṭisañcikkhato appossukkatāya cittaṃ namati, no dhammadesanāya.
mn26:20.1: atha kho bhikkhave brahmuno sahampatissa mama cetasā cetoparivitakkamaññāya etadahosi:
mn26:20.2: nassati vata bho loko, vinassati vata bho loko, yatra hi nāma tathāgatassa arahato sammāsambuddhassa appossukkatāya cittaṃ namati, no dhammadesanāyāti.
mn26:20.3: atha kho bhikkhave brahmā sahampati seyyāthāpi nāma balavā puriso sammiñjitaṃ vā bāhaṃ pasāreyya, pasāritaṃ vā bāhaṃ samiñjeyya, evamevaṃ brahmaloke antarahito mama purato pāturahosi.
mn26:20.4: atha kho bhikkhave brahmā sahampati ekaṃsaṃ uttarāsaṅgaṃ karitvā yenāhaṃ tenañjaliṃ paṇāmetvā maṃ etadavoca:
mn26:20.5: “desetu bhante bhagavā dhammaṃ. desetu sugato dhammaṃ.
mn26:20.6: santi sattā apparajakkhajātikā, assavaṇatā dhammassa parihāyanti.
mn26:21.1: atha khvāhaṃ bhikkhave brahmuno ca ajjhesanaṃ viditvā sattesu ca kāruññataṃ paṭicca buddhacakkhunā lokaṃ volokesiṃ.
mn26:21.2: addasaṃ kho ahaṃ bhikkhave buddhacakkhunā lokaṃ volokento satte apparajakkhe mahārajakkhe, tikkhindriye mudindriye, svākāre dvākāre suviññāpaye [duviññāpaye], appekacce paralokavajjabhayadassāvine viharante, [appekacce na paralokavajjabhayadassāvine viharante]
mn26:21.3: seyyathāpi nāma uppaliniyaṃ vā paduminiyaṃ vā puṇḍarīkiniyaṃ vā appekaccāni uppalāni vā padumāni vā puṇḍarīkāni vā udake jātāni udake saṃvaddhāni udakānuggatāni antonimuggaposīni, appekaccāni uppalāni vā padumāni vā puṇḍarīkāni vā udake jātāni udake saṃvaddhāni samodakaṃ ṭhitāni, appekaccāni uppalāni vā padumāni vā puṇḍarīkāni vā udake jātāni udake saṃvaddhāni udakaṃ accuggamma tiṭṭhanti anupalittāni udakena.
mn26:21.4: evameva kho ahaṃ bhikkhave buddhacakkhunā lokaṃ volokento addasaṃ satte apparajakkhe mahārajakkhe, tikkhindriye mudindriye, svākāre [dvākāre], suviññāpaye [duviññāpaye], appekacce paralokavajjabhayadassāvine viharante, [appekacce na paralokavajjabhayadassāvine viharante.]
mn26:21.5: atha khvāhaṃ bhikkhave brahmānaṃ sahampatiṃ gāthāya paccabhāsiṃ:
mn26:21.10: atha kho bhikkhave brahmā sahampati ‘katāvakāso khomhi bhagavatā dhammadesanāyā’ti maṃ abhivādetvā padakkhiṇaṃ katvā tatthevantaradhāyi.
mn26:22.2: kassa nu kho ahaṃ paṭhamaṃ dhammaṃ deseyyaṃ,
mn26:22.5: ‘ayaṃ kho āḷāro kālāmo paṇḍito byatto medhāvī, dīgharattaṃ apparajakkhajātiko.
mn26:22.6: yannūnāhaṃ āḷārassa kālāmassa paṭhamaṃ dhammaṃ deseyyaṃ,
mn26:22.8: atha kho maṃ bhikkhave devatā upasaṅkamitvā etadavoca:
mn26:22.14: sace hi so imaṃ dhammaṃ suṇeyya khippameva ājāneyyā’ti.
mn26:23.2: kassa nu kho ahaṃ paṭhamaṃ dhammaṃ deseyyaṃ,
mn26:23.5: ‘ayaṃ kho uddako rāmaputto paṇḍito byatto medhāvī, dīgharattaṃ apparajakkhajātiko.
mn26:23.6: yannūnāhaṃ uddakassa rāmaputtassa paṭhamaṃ dhammaṃ deseyyaṃ,
mn26:23.8: atha kho maṃ bhikkhave devatā upasaṅkamitvā etadavoca:
mn26:23.14: sace hi so imaṃ dhammaṃ suṇeyya khippameva ājāneyyā’ti.
mn26:24.2: kassa nu kho ahaṃ paṭhamaṃ dhammaṃ deseyyaṃ,
mn26:24.5: “bahukārā kho me pañcavaggiyā bhikkhū ye maṃ padhānapahitattaṃ upaṭṭhahiṃsu.
mn26:24.6: yannūnāhaṃ pañcavaggiyānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ paṭhamaṃ dhammaṃ deseyya”nti.
mn26:24.9: addasaṃ kho ahaṃ bhikkhave dibbena cakkhunā visuddhena atikkantamānusakena pañcavaggiye bhikkhū bārāṇasiyaṃ viharante isipatane migadāye.
mn26:24.10: atha khvāhaṃ bhikkhave uruvelāyaṃ yathābhirantaṃ viharitvā yena bārāṇasī tena cārikaṃ pakkamiṃ.
mn26:25.1: addasā kho maṃ bhikkhave upako ājīvako antarā ca gayaṃ antarā ca bodhiṃ addhānamagga paṭipannaṃ.
mn26:25.3: vippasannāni kho te āvuso indriyāni, parisuddho chavivaṇṇo pariyodāto.
mn26:25.4: kaṃsi tvaṃ āvuso uddissa pabbajito? ko vā te satthā? kassa vā tvaṃ dhammaṃ rocesīti?
mn26:25.5: evaṃ vutte ahaṃ bhikkhave upakaṃ ājīvakaṃ gāthāhi ajjhabhāsiṃ:
mn26:25.27: evaṃ vutte bhikkhave upako ājīvako ‘huveyyapāvuso’ti vatvā sīsaṃ okampetvā ummaggaṃ gahetvā pakkāmi.
mn26:26.1: atha khvāhaṃ bhikkhave anupubbena cārikaṃ caramāno yena bārāṇasī isipatanaṃ migadāyo yena pañcavaggiyā bhikkhū tenupasaṅkamiṃ.
mn26:26.2: addasāsuṃ kho maṃ bhikkhave pañcavaggiyā bhikkhū dūratova āgacchantaṃ.
mn26:26.4: “ayaṃ kho āvuso samaṇo gotamo āgacchati bāhuliko padhānavibbhanto āvatto bāhullāya.
mn26:26.5: so neva abhivādetabbo, na paccuṭṭhātabbo. nāssa pattacīvaraṃ paṭiggahetabbaṃ.
mn26:26.6: api ca kho āsanaṃ ṭhapetabbaṃ sace ākaṅkhissati nisīdissatī”ti.
mn26:26.7: yathā yathā kho ahaṃ bhikkhave upasaṅkamāmi, tathā tathā pañcavaggiyā bhikkhū nāsakkhiṃsu sakāya katikāya saṇṭhātuṃ.
mn26:26.8: appekacce maṃ paccuggantvā pattacīvaraṃ paṭiggahesuṃ. appekacce āsanaṃ paññāpesuṃ. appekacce pādodakaṃ upaṭṭhapesuṃ.
mn26:26.9: api ca kho maṃ nāmena ca āvusovādena ca samudācaranti.
mn26:27.1: evaṃ vutte ahaṃ bhikkhave pañcavaggiye bhikkhū etadavocaṃ:
mn26:27.2: “mā bhikkhave tathāgataṃ nāmena ca āvusovādena ca samudācarittha.
mn26:27.4: odahatha bhikkhave sotaṃ. amatamadhigataṃ. ahamanusāsāmi. ahaṃ dhammaṃ desemi.
mn26:27.5: yathānusiṭṭhaṃ tathā paṭipajjamānā nacirasseva yassatthāya kulaputtā sammadeva agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajanti, tadanuttaraṃ brahmacariyapariyosānaṃ diṭṭheva dhamme sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja viharissathā”ti.
mn26:27.6: evaṃ vutte bhikkhave pañcavaggiyā bhikkhū maṃ etadavocuṃ:
mn26:27.7: “tāyapi kho tvaṃ āvuso gotama iriyāya tāya paṭipadāya tāya dukkarakārikāya nājjhagamā uttarimanussadhammā alamariyañāṇadassanavisesaṃ. kiṃ pana tvaṃ etarahi bāhuliko padhānavibbhanto āvatto bāhullāya adhigamissasi uttarimanussadhammā alamariyañāṇadassanavisesanti.”
mn26:27.8: evaṃ vutte ahaṃ bhikkhave pañcavaggiye bhikkhū etadavocaṃ:
mn26:27.9: ‘na bhikkhave tathāgato bāhuliko, na padhānavibbhanto, na āvatto bāhullāya.
mn26:27.11: odahatha bhikkhave sotaṃ. amatamadhigataṃ. ahamanusāsāmi. ahaṃ dhammaṃ desemi.
mn26:27.12: yathānusiṭṭhaṃ tathā paṭipajjamānā nacirasseva yassatthāya kulaputtā sammadeva agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajanti, tadanuttaraṃ brahmacariyapariyosānaṃ diṭṭheva dhamme sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja viharissathā”ti.
mn26:27.13: dutiyampi kho bhikkhave pañcavaggiyā bhikkhū maṃ etadavocuṃ:
mn26:27.14: “tāyapi kho tvaṃ āvuso gotama iriyāya tāya paṭipadāya tāya dukkarakārikāya nājjhagamā uttarimanussadhammā alamariyañāṇadassanavisesaṃ. kimpana tvaṃ etarahi bāhuliko padhānavibbhanto āvatto bāhullāya adhigamissasi uttarimanussadhammā alamariyañāṇadassanavisesanti?”
mn26:27.15: dutiyampi kho ahaṃ bhikkhave pañcavaggiye bhikkhū etadavocaṃ:
mn26:27.16: “na bhikkhave tathāgato bāhuliko na padhānavibbhanto, na āvatto bāhullāya. arahaṃ bhikkhave tathāgato sammāsambuddho. odahatha bhikkhave sotaṃ. amatamadhigataṃ. ahamanusāsāmi. ahaṃ dhammaṃ desemi. yathānusiṭṭhaṃ tathā paṭipajjamānā nacirasseva yassatthāya kulaputtā sammadeva agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajanti, tadanuttaraṃ brahmacariyapariyosānaṃ diṭṭheva dhamme sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā
mn26:27.18: tatiyampi kho bhikkhave pañcavaggiyā bhikkhū maṃ etadavocuṃ:
mn26:27.19: “tāyapi kho tvaṃ āvuso gotama iriyāya tāya paṭipadāya tāya dukkarakārikāya nājjhagamā uttarimanussadhammā alamariyañāṇadassanavisesaṃ. kimpana tvaṃ etarahi bāhuliko padhānavibbhanto āvatto bāhullāya adhigamissasi uttarimanussadhammā alamariyañāṇadassanavisesanti?”
mn26:28.1: evaṃ vutte ahaṃ bhikkhave pañcavaggiye bhikkhū etadavocaṃ:
mn26:28.2: “abhijānātha me no tumhe bhikkhave ito pubbe evarūpaṃ vabbhāvitametanti
mn26:28.3: no hetaṃ bhante. na bhikkhave tathāgato bāhuliko, na padhānavibbhanto, na āvatto bāhullāya.
mn26:28.5: odahatha bhikkhave sotaṃ. amatamadhigataṃ. ahamanusāsāmi. ahaṃ dhammaṃ desemi.
mn26:28.6: yathānusiṭṭhaṃ tathā paṭipajjamānā nacirasseva yassatthāya kulaputtā sammadeva agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajanti, tadanuttaraṃ brahmacariyapariyosānaṃ diṭṭheva dhamme sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja viharissathā”ti.
mn26:29.1: asakkhiṃ kho ahaṃ bhikkhave pañcavaggiye bhikkhū saññāpetuṃ.
mn26:29.2: dvepi sudaṃ bhikkhave ovadāmi. tayo bhikkhū piṇḍāya caranti.
mn26:29.3: yaṃ tayo bhikkhū piṇḍāya caritvā āharanti, tena chabbaggā yāpema.
mn26:29.4: tayopi sudaṃ bhikkhave bhikkhū ovadāmi. dve bhikkhū piṇḍāya caranti.
mn26:29.5: yaṃ dve bhikkhū piṇḍāya caritvā āharantī, tena chabbaggiyā yāpema.
mn26:30.1: atha kho bhikkhave pañcavaggiyā bhikkhū mayā evaṃ ovadiyamānā evaṃ anusāsiyamānā attanā jātidhammā samānā jātidhamme ādīnavaṃ viditvā ajātaṃ anuttaraṃ yogakkhemaṃ nibbānaṃ pariyesamānā ajātaṃ anuttaraṃ yogakkhemaṃ nibbānaṃ ajjhagamaṃsu. attanā jarādhammā samānā jarādhamme ādīnavaṃ viditvā ajaraṃ anuttaraṃ yogakkhemaṃ nibbānaṃ pariyesamānā ajaraṃ anuttaraṃ yogakkhemaṃ nibbānaṃ ajjhagamaṃsu. attanā byādhidhammā samānā byādhidhamme ādīnavaṃ viditvā abyādhiṃ anuttaraṃ yogakkhemaṃ nibbānaṃ pariyesamānā abyādhiṃ anuttaraṃ yogakkhemaṃ nibbānaṃ ajjhagamaṃsu. attanā maraṇadhammā samānā maraṇadhamme ādīnavaṃ viditvā amataṃ anuttaraṃ yogakkhemaṃ nibbānaṃ pariyesamānā amataṃ anuttaraṃ yogakkhemaṃ nibbānaṃ ajjhagamaṃsu. attanā sokadhammā samānā sokadhamme ādīnavaṃ viditvā asokaṃ anuttaraṃ yogakkhemaṃ nibbānaṃ pariyesamānā asokaṃ anuttaraṃ yogakkhemaṃ nibbānaṃ ajjhagamaṃsu. attanā saṅkilesadhammā samānā saṅkilesadhamme ādīnavaṃ viditvā asaṅkiliṭṭhaṃ anuttaraṃ yogakkhemaṃ nibbānaṃ pariyesamānā asaṅkiliṭṭhaṃ anuttaraṃ yogakkhemaṃ nibbānaṃ ajjhagamaṃsu.
mn26:30.3: “akuppā no vimutti, ayamantimā jāti, natthidāni punabbhavo”ti.
mn26:31.3: cakkhuviññeyyā rūpā iṭṭhā kantā manāpā piyarūpā kāmūpasaṃhitā rajanīyā,
mn26:31.7: kāyaviññeyyā phoṭṭhabbā iṭṭhā kantā manāpā piyarūpā kāmūpasaṃhitā rajanīyā.
mn26:32.1: ye hi keci bhikkhave samaṇā vā brāhmaṇā vā ime pañca kāmaguṇe gathitā mucchitā ajjhāpannā anādīnavadassāvino anissaraṇapaññā paribhuñjanti, te evamassu veditabbā:
mn26:32.3: seyyathāpi bhikkhave āraññako migo baddho pāsarāsiṃ adhisayeyya.
mn26:32.6: āgacchante ca pana ludde na yena kāmaṃ pakkamissatīti.
mn26:32.7: evameva kho bhikkhave ye hi keci samaṇā vā brāhmaṇā vā ime pañca kāmaguṇe gathitā mucchitā ajjhāpannā anādīnavadassāvino anissaraṇapaññā paribhuñjanti, te evamassu veditabbā:
mn26:33.1: ye ca kho keci bhikkhave samaṇā vā brāhmaṇā vā ime pañca kāmaguṇe agathitā amucchitā anajjhāpannā ādīnavadassāvino nissaraṇapaññā paribhuñjanti, te evamassu veditabbā:
mn26:33.2: na anayamāpannā na byasanamāpannā na yathākāmakaraṇīyā pāpimato.
mn26:33.3: seyyathāpi bhikkhave āraññako migo abaddho pāsarāsiṃ adhisayeyya,
mn26:33.5: na anayamāpanno na byasanamāpanno na yathākāmakaraṇīyo luddassa,
mn26:33.6: āgacchante ca pana ludde yena kāmaṃ pakkamissatīti.
mn26:33.7: evameva kho bhikkhave ye keci samaṇā vā brāhmaṇā vā ime pañca kāmaguṇe agathitā amucchitā anajjhāpannā ādīnavadassāvino nissaraṇapaññā paribhuñjanti, te evamassu veditabbā:
mn26:33.8: na anayamāpannā na byasanamāpannā na yathākāmakaraṇīyā pāpimato.
mn26:34.1: seyyathāpi bhikkhave āraññako migo araññe pavane vissattho gacchati, vissattho tiṭṭhati, vissattho nisīdati, vissattho seyyaṃ kappeti.
mn26:34.4: evameva kho bhikkhave bhikkhu vivicceva kāmehi vivicca akusalehi savitakkaṃ savicāraṃ vivekajaṃ pītisukhaṃ paṭhamaṃjhānaṃ upasampajja viharati.
mn26:34.5: ayaṃ vuccati bhikkhave bhikkhu ‘andhamakāsi māraṃ, apadaṃ vadhitvā māracakkhuṃ adassanaṃ gato pāpimato’.
mn26:35.1: puna caparaṃ bhikkhave bhikkhu vitakkavicārānaṃ vūpasamā ajjhattaṃ sampasādanaṃ cetaso ekodibhāvaṃ avitakkaṃ avicāraṃ samādhijaṃ pītisukhaṃ dutiyaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharati.
mn26:35.2: ayaṃ vuccati bhikkhave bhikkhu ‘andhamakāsi māraṃ, apadaṃ vadhitvā māracakkhuṃ adassanaṃ gato pāpimato’.
mn26:36.1: puna caparaṃ bhikkhave bhikkhu pītiyā ca virāgā upekkhako ca viharati sato ca sampajāno, sukhañca kāyena paṭisaṃvedeti yantaṃ ariyā ācikkhanti: upekkhako satimā sukhavihārīti tatiyaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharati.
mn26:36.2: ayaṃ vuccati bhikkhave bhikkhu ‘andhamakāsi māraṃ, apadaṃ vadhitvā māracakkhuṃ adassanaṃ gato pāpimato’.
mn26:37.1: puna caparaṃ bhikkhave bhikkhu sukhassa ca pahānā dukkhassa ca pahānā pubbeva somanassadomanassānaṃ atthagamā adukkhaṃ asukhaṃ upekkhāsatipārisuddhiṃ catutthaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharati.
mn26:37.2: ayaṃ vuccati bhikkhave bhikkhu ‘andhamakāsi māraṃ, apadaṃ vadhitvā māracakkhuṃ adassanaṃ gato pāpimato’.
mn26:38.1: puna caparaṃ bhikkhave bhikkhu sabbaso rūpasaññānaṃ samatikkamā paṭighasaññānaṃ atthagamā nānattasaññānaṃ amanasikārā ananto ākāsoti ākāsānañcāyatanaṃ upasampajja viharati.
mn26:38.2: ayaṃ vuccati bhikkhave bhikkhu ‘andhamakāsi māraṃ, apadaṃ vadhitvā māracakkhuṃ adassanaṃ gato pāpimato’.
mn26:39.1: puna caparaṃ bhikkhave bhikkhu sabbaso ākāsānañcāyatanaṃ samatikkamma anantaṃ viññāṇanti viññāṇañcāyatanaṃ upasampajja viharati
mn26:40.1: sabbaso viññāṇañcāyatanaṃ samatikkamma natthi kiñcīti [ākiñcaññāyatanaṃ upasampajja viharati
mn26:42.1: puna caparaṃ bhikkhave bhikkhu sabbaso] nevasaññānāsaññāyatanaṃ samatikkamma saññāvedayitanirodhaṃ upasampajja viharati. paññāya cassa disvā āsavā parikkhīṇā honti.
mn26:42.2: ayaṃ vuccati bhikkhave bhikkhu andhamakāsi māraṃ, apadaṃ vadhitvā māracakkhuṃ adassanaṃ gato pāpimato.
mn26:42.3: tiṇṇo loke visattikaṃ. so vissattho gacchati. vissattho tiṭṭhati. vissattho nisīdati. vissattho seyyaṃ kappeti.
mn26:42.7: attamanā te bhikkhū bhagavato bhāsitaṃ abhinandunti.
